skill.summary: Monitors research topics for new papers, conferences, and journals.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Added deduplication: now checks if research items (by URL or title) were previously seen and skips repeats.
- Introduced new script commands: --check-seen and --mark-seen for managing seen items.
- Updated reporting workflow to mark newly reported items as seen.
- Revised documentation for improved clarity and to detail the updated item tracking process.
